```yaml
name: Copilot SDK CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  setup-node:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: kubb-labs/config/.github/setup@main
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: true
          force-install: false

  install-dependencies:
    needs: setup-node
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: make deps-copilot-client

  build:
    needs: install-dependencies
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Build TypeScript client
        run: make copilot-client

  test:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Run tests
        run: make test-copilot-client

  codecov:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./coverage/lcov.info
          directory: .
          exclude: []
          coverage-format: cobertura
          disable-search: false
          fail-ci-if-error: true
          handle-no-reports-found: ignore
          verbose: false
          flags: ''
          name: copilot-sdk
          base-branch: main
          junit-xml-pattern: ''
          enable-tests: true
          enable-coverage: true

  publish-results:
    needs: codecov
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Publish test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          github_token_actor: ${{ github.actor }}
          github_retries: 3
          ssl_verify: true
          commit: ${{ github.sha }}
          check_name: Copilot SDK Tests
          comment_title: Test Results
          comment_mode: append
          fail_on: any
          action_fail: true
          action_fail_on_inconclusive: false
          files: './coverage/lcov.info'
          junit_files: ''
          nunit_files: ''
          xunit_files: ''
```
